title: Uffizi
summary: Ms. Uffizi is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council. Currently quartered in Huntik International HQ with the other members, she speaks with a distinctive Italian accent.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Uffizi was present at Metz' holographic meeting of the Huntik council where she voiced her approval of the fact that the Council members were putting aside their rivalries and working in tandem. [Coming of Age]

Uffizi believed that the Organization would be very weak without the Professor's leadership but was reminded by Higgans that they were still dangerous. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Uffizi was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Uffizi was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Uffizi joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon]

Uffizi was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Uffizi was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. == History ==
Uffizi was present at [[Metz]]' holographic meeting of the Huntik council where she voiced her approval of the fact that the Council members were putting aside their rivalries and working in tandem. {{Source|Coming of Age}}

Uffizi believed that [[the Organization]] would be very weak without [[the Professor|the Professor's]] leadership but was reminded by [[Higgans]] that they were still dangerous. {{source|The Tower of Nostradamus}}

Uffizi was later present when [[Focauld Casterwill]] alerted [[Teien Casterwill]] that the [[Blood Spiral]] had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}} Uffizi was also present when [[Dante]]'s team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission [[Call of the Casterwill]]. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}

Uffizi joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the [[Spiral Mark]]. {{source|Words from Eathon}}

==Personality==
Uffizi appears to be a professional individual and keen to put aside rivalries in order to achieve a common goal. She also seemed to be glad that the [[Huntik Foundation Council|Council]] met again. {{source|Coming of Age}}
